scope: Workspace isolation, upload follow-up boundaries and pre-write GitHub authority checks; development preview only

negative_controls.method: Selected new tests against baseline production files in a separate temporary worktree; original working files restored afterward.

validation_boundaries: HTTP contract tests use loopback synthetic credentials, not live provider accounts.
Concurrent handlers run in the test I/O context against real local D1/DO/R2; sequential integration tests retain SELF.fetch.
No live provider task, production migration, paid cloud resource, GitHub Actions dispatch, native installer build or release.
GitHub source publication is not acceptance of the product-internal GitHub publication flow.
